objectives: Know where authoritative tracheostomy guidance sits and that no care content is yet drafted.

items.text: For a transfer, take appropriate tracheostomy spares in line with the National Tracheostomy Safety Project (ICS 2026 recommendation 60; UK).
Tracheostomy care, inner-cannula care, tube changes and emergencies follow the unit's approved procedure and the surgical/respiratory team's instructions. No source for the steps has been read.

checklist.text: Confirm the tube type and the unit's emergency equipment arrangement before any care.
Call for help immediately for any airway emergency per unit protocol.
Record care given and the patient's response per unit standard.
